planets.name: TOI-469 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-469 with a 13.6-day year, found in 2021.

text.card: TOI-469 b was found in 2021 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-469. Its orbit and size follow Egger et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
